auth.description: Datadog API key. Identifies the organization; required on every request together with the Application Key — neither key alone authenticates a call
auth.name: datadog.api_key
auth.subject: unstated

auth.description: Datadog Application Key, scoped to the user who created it. Required on every request together with the API Key — neither key alone authenticates a call
auth.name: datadog.application_key
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: Organization Settings > API Keys in the Datadog app. Sent as DD-API-KEY on every request, always together with the Application Key
config.label: Datadog API Key
config.name: api_key

config.help: Organization Settings > Application Keys in the Datadog app, scoped to the user who creates it. Sent as DD-APPLICATION-KEY on every request, always together with the API Key
config.label: Datadog Application Key
config.name: application_key

description: Datadog monitoring: list and inspect monitors, list and inspect incidents. Authenticates every request with an API key and an Application key together

operations.description: List every monitor visible to this API key. Also this connector's `verify` — a bounded read that runs unattended, needing no argument

creator.description: The user who created this monitor; may be absent for a system-authored monitor. Carries a name and an email address — personal data, never given an example value here

id.description: Datadog's numeric id for this monitor

message.description: The notification message template; may embed @-mentions and template variables

modified.description: When this monitor was last modified

multi.description: Whether this is a multi-alert monitor grouped by tag

options.description: Evaluation and notification settings (thresholds, notify_no_data, renotify_interval, evaluation_delay, and more) — left untyped rather than enumerated in full; see Datadog's own Monitor Options reference for the complete shape

overall_state.description: The monitor's current alert state, e.g. "OK", "Alert", "Warn", "No Data"

query.description: The monitor's evaluation query, in Datadog's own monitor query syntax

type.description: The monitor's evaluation type, e.g. "metric alert", "query alert", "service check", "log alert", "composite"
